senses.gloss:
m. (-धिः)
Anxiety, mental pain; more usually आधिः.
E.
आङ before, धा to have, कि affix; आ is made short.

ind.
Over, above, upon, &c. a preposition and prefix to verbs implying superiority in place, quality, or quantity; as अधिष्ठातुं to stand in or on, अधिकर्त्तुं to rule over, अधिशयितुं to exceed: also used in the figurative sense of the same, as अधिगन्तुं to go to or attain; अधिकर्त्तुं to do over again, to repeat or recall; अधीतुं to go over or through, as a book; अधिवस्तुं to reside in or on, to continue in or on, to persevere: forming also indeclinables with nouns, as अधिरात्रि in the night; अधि ग्रहं in or over the house: and compounds with nouns, as अधिदेवप्ता, &c. q. v.
E.
अ neg. धा to have, कि aff.

m. (-धिः)
1 Mental agony, anxiety.
2 Expectation.
3 Definition.
4 A pledge, a pawn, a mortgage.
5 Location, fixing, site, &c.
6 Engagement.
E.
आङ्, ध्यै to reflect, and कि aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Exceeding, more, over, more than, in addition to.
n. (-कं)
A figure in rhetoric, (Hyperbole.)
E.
अधि and क, from कै to sound.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
More, comparatively more.
E.
अधिक and तरप् aff.

mfn. (-मः-मा-भं)
Most, superlatively more.
E.
अधिक, and तमप् aff.

f. (-ता)
Excess, addition; also अधिकत्वं.
E.
ता or त्व added to अधिक.

ind.
Moreover.
E.
अधिक, and तु but.

n. (-णं)
1 Superiority, supremacy.
2 Title, right.
3 In the Mīmāṃsā philosophy, a case or topic, comprehending five members, the subject, the doubt, the first side or prima facie argument, the answer or conclusion, the application.
4 (In the Vedānta.) A case or question.
5 (In grammar) Location, the sense of the seventh or locative case, defined to imply four kinds: .²1 Proximity, as, ‘a village on the Ganges.’ .²2 Inclusion, as, ‘the gods in heaven.’ .²3 End or object, as, ‘versed in the Śāstras; and .²4 Integral existence, as, ‘the spirit is in all.’
E.
अधि over, कृ to do; and ल्युट् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Pledging, mortgaging.
2 A pledge.
E.
आधि and करण making, &c. with च्चि inserted.

mfn. (-र्द्धिः-र्द्धिः-र्द्धि)
Prosperous, every way happy.
E.
अधिक excessive, and ऋद्धि prosperity.

n. (-र्म्म)
Superintendence, supervision.
E.
अधि, and कर्म्म business.

m. (-कः)
1 Clerk or prefect of the market or fair.
2 An overseer, a superintendent.
E.
अधि over, कर्म्म business, and इक् aff.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं)
Having more members than natural or common.
n. (-ङ्गं)
The girdle over the coat of mail, worn as a kind of scarf.
E.
अधिक exceeding, and अङ्ग the body.

m. (-रः)
1 Authority.
2 Supremacy.
3 Rule, government.
4 Right, title.
5 Property, ownership.
6 Privilege.
7 Duty, office.
3 A chapter, a section.
9 The use of royal insignia.
10 (In grammar) Government, the dependance of a form on a previous one.
E.
अधि over, and कार what makes, from कृ with घञ् affix; what gives or exercises preeminence.

m. (-रः)
Superintendence, authority, &c. See अधिकार.

f. (-ता)
1 Ownership, lordship.
2 Right, title.
E.
अधिकारिन् with ता affix.

n. (-त्वं)
1 Ownership.
2 Right, title.
E.
see the last, affix त्व.

m. (-री)
1 A superintendent, a ruler, a director.
2 A master, an owner.
3 A sage, one who is perfect in the principles and practice of the Vedānta.
mf. (-री-रिणी)
(In law) The possessor of a right or title, as, धनाधिकारी heir to property; संस्काराधिकारी one who has a right to the essential ceremonies of the Hindu religion.
E.
अधिकार, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Superintended, guided.
2 Claimed or held as a right.
3 Set over, superintendent.
m. (-तः)
1 A superintendent in general.
2 Inspector of receipts and disbursements, an auditor of public accompts.
E.
अधि over, and कृत made.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Pledged, pawned, mortgaged.
E.
आधि and कृत made, with च्चि augment.

m. (-मः)
Invasion, assailing.
E.
अधि over, and क्रम to go.

n. (-णं)
Invading, assailing, overrunning.
E.
अधि, and क्रमण going.

f. (-तिः)
A possession, a right.
E.
अधि, and कृति doing.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
1 Censured, reviled, detracted from.
2 Sent, dispatched.
3 Placed, fixed.
E.
अधि, and क्षिप्त participle of क्षिप to send or throw.

m. (-पः)
1 Detraction, censure.
2 Sending, despatching.
E.
अधि, and क्षेप throwing.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Obtained.
2 Gone through or over, lit. or fig. as read, studied.
E.
अधि, and गत gone.

m. (-मः)
1 Obtaining, attaining, acquiring.
2 Going through or over, lit. or fig.
3 Overpassing, overflowing: also अधिगमन n. (-नं) &c.
E.
अधि, and गम or गमन going.

mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं)
Unattainable, not to be reached or acquired. So अधिगमनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) and अधिगन्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं).
E.
अधिगम with यत्, अनीयर or तव्य participial affs.

m. (-ह्वः)
A tumor on the tongue.
E.
अधि, and जिह्वा the tongue.

n. (-षं)
The luminous parts of the creation.
E.
अधि supreme, ज्योतिष् light.

f. (-का)
Land on the upper part of a mountain.
E.
अधि over, above, and त्यकन् aff.

m. (-न्तः)
A tooth growing over another.
E.
अधि, and दन्त a tooth.

m. (-वः)
1 A supreme or superior deity.
2 A tutelary deity.
E.
अधि, and देव a deity.

m. (-ता)
A tutelary or presiding divinity.
E.
अधि, and देवता a deity.

n. (-वं)
1 The ruling deity, the active principle in creation: also अधिदैवतं.
2 The collective body of gods, and superhuman beings.
E.
अधि, and दैव divine being.

m. (-पः)
1 An owner, a lord or master.
2 A king.
E.
अधि, and प who preserves, from पा.

m. (-तिः)
A master, an owner, a ruler.
2 A king.
E.
अधि, and पति a master.

n. (-जं)
Continuation of the world by procreation.
E.
अधि, and प्रजा progeny.

m. (-भूः)
A master, a ruler.
E.
अधि, and भू who is from भू to be, affix विच्.

n. (-तं)
An essential element of matter, perishable matter, that of which the presence involves eventual dissolution.
E.
अधि over, and भ्रूत an element.

m. (-न्थः)
Acute pains in the balls of the eyes, with pain and swelling of one side of the head.
E.
अधि over, मन्य what agitates.

m. (-सः)
Fleshy excrescences on the eye, cancer of the eye.
E.
अधि, and मांस flesh.

m. (-कः)
Inflammation of the tonsils.
E.
अधि, and मांस flesh, कन् added.

n. (-त्रं)
A knowledge of the properties of the letters forming the word for the Hindu triad ओम्.
E.
अधि, and मात्र the whole.

m. (-सः)
An intercalary month, formed of the aggregate days omitted in reckoning the lunar year.
E.
अधि, and मास a month.

m. (-थः)
A charioteer.
E.
अधि, and रथ a car.

m. (-राट्)
A supreme king, an emperor. So अधिराज m. (-जः)
E.
अधि, and राज् राजन a king.

n. (-ज्यं)
Empire, supreme sway.
E.
अधि, and राज्य kingdom.

n. (-ज्यं)
Supreme sway, royalty, royal government.
E.
अधिराज and ष्यञ् aff.

m. (-क्)
An emperor, a paramount sovereign.
E.
अधिराज्य, and भाज् who possesses.

mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
Elevated, exalted, surmounting.
E.
अधि, and रूढ mounted.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Placed over, lit. or fig.
E.
अधि, and रोपित raised.

m. (-हः)
Surmounting, overtopping, elevation.
E.
अधि, and रोह mounting.

f. (-णी)
A ladder, a pair of steps.
E.
अधि, and रुह to mount, with ल्युट् affix, and fem. ङीष.

mfn. (-हि-हिणी-हि)
Who rises on or above.
f. (-णी)
A ladder, a staircase.
E.
अधिरोह, and इनि aff.

m. (-कः)
The universe, the material world.
E.
अधि, and लोक world.

n. (-नं)
A name, an appellation.
E.
अधि, and वचन speech.

m. (-सः)
1 A house, an abode.
2 Place, situation.
3 Continuance, perseverance.
4 Perfuming the person, &c.
5 A neighbour.
6 Neighbourhood.
E.
अधि, and वस to dwell, with घञ् affix; or पास to fumigate, with अच्.

n. (-नं)
1 Perfuming or scenting the person, &c.
2 Abiding, staying.
3 A religious ceremony; touching a vessel containing perfumes, flowers, and other things previously presented to an idol, or offering perfumes, &c. to idols, as a preliminary ceremony.
E.
अधि, and वास to fumigate, ल्युट aff.

f. (-ता)
Residence, staying or abiding in one place.
E.
अधिवास, with ता affix, and इट augment; also with त्व, अधिवासित्वं.

f. (-द्या)
The collective means and end of acquiring knowledge.
E.
अधि, and विद्या knowledge.

f. (-न्ना)
A wife whose husband has subsequently married others; a superseded wife.
E.
अधि, and विन्न obtained.

m. (-त्ता)
A man marrying other than his first wife.
E.
अधि before विद to obtain, तृच् aff.

n. (-नं)
Marrying again, whilst a former wife is living.
E.
अधि before विद to obtain, affix ल्युट्.

f. (-या)
A wife deserving or proper to be superseded.
E.
अधि before विद to obtain, अनीयर aff.

m. (-यः)
A place, a receptacle.
E.
अधि before श्रि to serve, अच् aff.

f. (-णी)
A furnace or fire-place.
E.
अधि, and श्रिङ to cook, ल्युट् affix, and fem. termination.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Placed, deposited, received, included.
E.
अधि, before श्रि to serve, क्त aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Abiding, resting.
2 Site, situation.
3 Prescribed rule, fixed practice.
5 A town.
6 A wheel.
4 Dignity.
E.
अधि, श्या to stand, and ल्यट् aff.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Governing, directing, fixing.
m. (-ता)
A ruler, a governor, a director.
E.
अधि before स्था to stay, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Fixed, determined, established; literally or figuratively, as a house or a practice.
2 Supervised, overlooked.
3 Guarded, surrounded.
4 Appointed.
E.
अधि, and स्थित stationed.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Read, read through.
E.
the participial deriv. from अधी to read over, or study.

m. (-दः)
A Brahman, who has read the Vedas; a student who has finished his course of study.
E.
अधीत, and वेद the Veda.

f. (-तिः)
Study, perusal.
E.
अधी to read, and क्तिन् aff.

mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति)
A scholar, one who has finished his studies.
E.
अधीत, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Docile.
2 Dependant.
E.
अधि, and इन a master.

f. (-ता)
Subjection, dependance, slavery: so अधीनत्व (-त्वं)
E.
ता or त्व added to the last.

m. (-नः)
A student, one going over or reading the Vedas, &c.
E.
अधि before इ to go, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Confused, perplexed.
2 Unsteady, (lit. or met.)
f. (-रा)
1 Lightning.
2 An offended, cross or capricious mistress or wife.
E.
अ neg. and धीर firm, steady.

f. (-ता)
Fickleness, unsteadiness; also अधीरत्वं.
E.
ता or त्व added to the last.

m. (-शः)
A master, a lord.
E.
अधि, and ईश master.

m. (-रः)
An emperor, a king paramount over all the neighbouring princes.
E.
अधि superior, and ईश्वर a lord.

n. (-क्यं)
Excess.
E.
अधिक more, ष्यज aff.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Produced by pain, &c.
E.
आधि pain, and ज produced.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
1 Crooked.
2 Pained, distressed.
E.
आधि pain, &c. and ज्ञ who knows.

n. (-ण्यं)
1 Possession.
2 Location.
E.
अधिकरण्य, and ष्यञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Supreme, superior, relating or belonging to any thing or person of importance or sway.
2 Official, relating to any office or duty.
E.
अधिकार and ठञ् aff.

n. (-त्वं)
Nature or circumstance of a pledge.
E.
आधि and त्व aff.

m. (-धिः)
The object or purpose with which a pledge is given, the conditions or terms of a mortgage.
E.
आधित्व and उपाधि condition.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Relating to, a tutelary or presiding deity.
E.
अधिदैव and ठञ् aff.

n. (-त्यं)
Power, supremacy, sovereignty.
E.
अधिपति a lord or master, &c. व्यञ् aff.

m. (-गः)
Usufruct, enjoyment or use of a deposit, use of a horse, cow, &c. pledged.
E.
आधि a pledge, and भोग enjoyment.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Elementary, derived or produced from the primitive elements.
E.
अधिभूत a material cause, ठञ् aff.

m. (-वः)
Feverish heat or burning.
E.
आधि and मन्यु distress, अण् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Property, &c. given to a first wife upon marrying a second.
E.
अधि before विद to know, and ल्युट् affix, अधिवेदन, ठक् aff.

ind.
Having pledged.
E.
आधि with कृत्य having done, च्चि augment.
